title: Genome-wide CRISPR guide RNA design and specificity analysis with GuideScan2
authors: Henri Schmidt, Minsi Zhang, Dimitar Chakarov, Vineet Bansal, Haralambos Mourelatos, Francisco J. Sánchez-Rivera, Scott W. Lowe, Andrea Ventura, Christina S. Leslie, Yuri Pritykin
relevance_to_cellguide: A candidate open-source replacement for Benchling in the plan's Workstream B1 'candidate generator' (gene -> valid SpCas9 guides + scores) if Benchling access is limited — the plan's own risk table (§7) flags 'Guide-score/API access varies across tools... Benchling can be replaced by open guide enumeration/scoring.' GuideScan2 provides exactly that: memory-efficient genome-wide gRNA database construction + specificity scoring, with demonstrated identification of confounding low-specificity guides in published screens.
